newsitem.title: USA: ITT Educational responds to civil actions.
newsitem.headline: ITT Educational responds to civil actions.

text.p: ITT Educational Services Inc said Monday it intends to vigorously defend itself against six lawsuits recently filed against the company, all in Superior Court of San Diego County in San Diego, Calif.

It said five of the suits, involving 17 former students of the Hospitality Management program of the San Diego ITT Technical Institute, allege statutory violations of the California Education Code and California Business and Professional Code.

They also allege intentional misrepresentation and civil conspiracy by the company, ITT Corp and a company employee who lives in California. ITT Educational was spun off from ITT Corp in December 1994, though ITT Corp still holds an 83 percent stake in the company.
The sixth suit alleges similar statutory violations by the company and 10 company employees who live in California and seeks to have the action certified as a class action.

The technical skills school company said the allegations in the six suits are similar to claims alleged in Eldredge et al versus ITT Educational. It is appealing a jury verdict in that case, which alleged misrepresentation of certain aspects of the company's hospitality management program.
ITT Educational's stock ended off 7/8 at 22-3/4.
